svg.title: Anti-windup compared with windup
svg.desc: With the heater's real 100 percent limit declared, the stored integral reaches only 90.6 percent instead of 113.2 percent, the heater leaves full power at the return at 10.0 seconds instead of 12.0, the water peaks at 39.31 instead of 39.57 degrees Celsius and is back within 0.2 degrees at 29.2 instead of 44.8 seconds.
svg.text: Simulator runs of Lessons 7 and 8 · same hot start and setpoint changes · numbers answer the predictions
Leaves full power at 10.0 s (Lesson 7: 12.0 s)
